name: Ringg AI API Documentation
description: This is the documentation for the Ringg AI APIs. The Ringg AI API follows RESTful principles, making it intuitive and easy to integrate with your applications. All API requests should be made to the base URL. The API accepts and returns data in JSON format. Ensure your requests include the appropriate Content-Type header for POST and PATCH requests.
